data.name: Alekhya
data.gender_notes: Alekhya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who writes or records. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'alokaya' meaning 'to see' or 'to perceive'. In Hindu mythology, Alekhya is the goddess of writing and knowledge. The name Alekhya carries the meaning “Scribe, writer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Alekhya usually hope their child will grow to embody scribe, writer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of knowledge and the importance of recording and preserving it for future generations.
data.etymology: Alekhya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Scribe, writer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alekhya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
